scope: WaveSurfer.js OSS region playback, MediaElement boundary events, exact stop, click/seek and lifecycle research for Enjoy. URLs were checked on the accessed date.

sources.title: Enjoy package dependency
sources.claim: Enjoy declares wavesurfer.js ^7.9.1.
sources.limitations: Static package evidence; does not prove the runtime bundle or browser behavior.

sources.title: WaveSurfer regions.ts at tag 7.9.1
sources.claim: region.play(stopAtEnd) only forwards end when true; region-in/out comes from timeupdate membership; region playback delegates to wavesurfer.play(start, end).
sources.limitations: Exact tag source, not a guarantee that an installed bundle was built from it.

sources.title: WaveSurfer wavesurfer.ts at tag 7.9.1
sources.claim: The 16 ms timer emits progress events and pauses at stopAtPosition; MediaElement native events are bridged; play(start, end) sets the start and stop position.
sources.limitations: Implementation detail of 7.9.1; later fixes change exact-stop behavior.

sources.title: WaveSurfer player.ts at tag 7.9.1
sources.claim: The player delegates play/pause to the media element and clamps setTime to duration.
sources.limitations: Does not by itself explain browser-specific event ordering.

sources.title: Official regions example at tag 7.9.1
sources.claim: The click path uses region.play(true) for bounded playback and uses region.play() only for loop after region-out.
sources.limitations: Example behavior is not an application contract.

sources.title: Regions no-audio Cypress test at tag 7.9.1
sources.claim: setTime can emit region-in while isPlaying remains false.
sources.limitations: This is a test of event semantics, not a browser playback failure rate.

sources.title: Feat: play(start, stop)
sources.claim: Introduced bounded play(start, stop); PR notes MediaElement watches timeupdate and is not precise.
sources.limitations: PR description is not a precision benchmark and does not cover Enjoy's handlers.

sources.title: Chrome fires region-out immediately on region.play with MediaElement
sources.claim: A Chrome MediaElement reproduction reports immediate region-out and a handler that pauses playback.
sources.limitations: Browser/version-specific user report; no incidence rate and no direct Enjoy trace.

sources.title: High-precision region boundaries cause region-out after click
sources.claim: A high-decimal start 9.16454684654654 triggers region-out immediately after region-clicked on Chrome.
sources.limitations: Single reproduction, not proof that every decimal boundary fails.

sources.title: region-in and region-out almost simultaneous
sources.claim: A report measured a 7 ms gap between region-in and region-out for decimal boundaries.
sources.limitations: One report and measurement environment; no general error distribution.

sources.title: region.play on dragged region can fail
sources.claim: A dragged float region can fail when region-out is used to pause; rounding to three decimals was reported as unreliable workaround.
sources.limitations: User report; it does not establish whether rounding, event order or another factor dominates.

sources.title: Fix regions region event race
sources.claim: Adds 0.05 second start-boundary tolerance for region-in/out detection, with tests for high-precision start seek, resolving #3631, #3781 and #3866.
sources.limitations: Release containing this merge was not verified; it is absent from installed 7.9.1.

sources.title: Fix stop playback exactly at requested position
sources.claim: Clamps MediaElement overshoot to stopAtPosition and fixes WebAudio delay at non-1x playback rate.
sources.limitations: Fixes end-boundary precision, not the early region-out race at start.

sources.title: WaveSurfer.js release 7.12.8
sources.claim: Release notes include the exact-stop fix from PR #4318.
sources.limitations: Upgrade compatibility with Enjoy is not tested here.

sources.title: Region playback boundary problem
sources.claim: A 7.x user reports playback continuing past region boundaries and asks for precise stop/reset behavior.
sources.limitations: Closed request without a general benchmark; does not identify Enjoy's failure.

sources.title: Fix region clicked and seek issues
sources.claim: Checks parentElement in virtual append to prevent redundant DOM operations that broke region click/seek under zoom.
sources.limitations: Secondary click/seek branch; it does not explain an early region-out event.

sources.title: WaveSurfer.js release 7.8.10
sources.claim: Release notes include fixes for region click and seek issues.
sources.limitations: Does not cover the later exact-stop or start-boundary race fixes.

sources.title: Fix lazy region setOptions visibility
sources.claim: Fixes stale lazy-rendered region UI after start/end changes while paused.
sources.limitations: Rendering state, not playback event order; only relevant if trace shows stale region geometry.

sources.title: Fix timer and listener leaks
sources.claim: Fixes timer listener/rAF leaks, duplicate once listeners and Regions virtualAppend subscriptions.
sources.limitations: Does not prove a leak in Enjoy; use only as a reason to test instance recreation and cleanup.

sources.title: Official wavesurfer-react lifecycle wrapper
sources.claim: The wrapper cleans event subscriptions, recreates instances on selected option identity changes and expects plugin arrays to be memoized.
sources.limitations: Enjoy does not use this wrapper directly; it is a lifecycle reference only.

sources.title: WaveSurfer React event listener cleanup discussion
sources.claim: Maintainer guidance recommends effect cleanup through the unsubscribe returned by on and memoizing the regions plugin instance.
sources.limitations: Discussion guidance, not a defect report or Enjoy runtime evidence.
